_description: Historical national goals for the Old World Order 1450 scenario.

goals.name: Heir of Rome (Kayser-i Rûm)
goals.description: Capture Constantinople, breach the Theodosian Walls, and proclaim the Sultan as the legitimate successor to the Roman emperors.

goals.name: Anatolian Unification
goals.description: Integrate the independent Turkish beyliks of Karaman, Candar, and Dulkadir to consolidate undisputed Ottoman sovereignty over Anatolia.

goals.name: Fortify the Danubian March
goals.description: Secure the fortress line along the Danube river against Hungarian and crusader counter-offensives.

goals.name: End the Hundred Years' War
goals.description: Liberate the duchies of Normandy and Guyenne, expelling the English crown from French continental soil.

goals.name: Compagnies d'Ordonnance
goals.description: Institutionalize France's first professional standing army financed by a permanent royal tax (taille).

goals.name: Contain the Grand Dukes of the West
goals.description: Check the territorial expansion of the House of Burgundy in Flanders, Picardy, and the Rhineland.

goals.name: Fortress Calais & the Narrow Seas
goals.description: Strengthen the fortifications of the Calais Pale and maintain naval mastery over the English Channel.

goals.name: Guard the Northern Marches
goals.description: Secure the Scottish Border Marches and neutralize the threat of a northern Auld Alliance invasion.

goals.name: Restore Royal Solvency
goals.description: Reorganize the exchequer, manage war debts, and restore parliamentary confidence in the Crown.

goals.name: Complete the Reconquista
goals.description: Besiege and capture the Emirate of Granada, concluding seven centuries of Christian reconquest in Iberia.

goals.name: The Catholic Monarchs
goals.description: Forge a permanent dynastic alliance between Castile and Aragon to form a united Spanish monarchy.

goals.name: Chart the Ocean Sea
goals.description: Sponsor intrepid navigators to seek a westward sea route across the Atlantic.

goals.name: Chart the African Coast
goals.description: Push maritime caravels southward past Guinea to map the southern extremity of the African continent.

goals.name: Maritime Spice Monopoly
goals.description: Establish armed feitorias along the Indian Ocean to secure the exclusive maritime spice trade.

goals.name: Overcome the Tumu Crisis
goals.description: Rally the imperial court under Minister Yu Qian, fortify Beijing, and repel the Oirat Mongol invaders.

goals.name: Stone Walls of the Ming Frontier
goals.description: Construct contiguous stone and brick watchtowers along the northern frontier passes to ensure enduring peace.

goals.name: Dredge the Grand Canal
goals.description: Reconstruct and dredge the 1,700-kilometer Grand Canal to guarantee continuous grain shipments from the Yangtze to the capital.
